name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, bend your knees with your feet slightly bowed out. Arch your back above your knees, and start with the weights touching in front of your chest.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row
instructions: Hinge forward at the hips while maintaining a flat back. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand, lay on an incline bench that's at about 15-30 degrees.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Dumbbell Laying Reverse Fly Internally Rotated
instructions: With dumbbells in either hand and an overhand grip, lay on an incline bench that is roughly 15 - 30 degrees high.
With bent elbows, raise your arms up to shoulder level, pausing at the at the end of the motion.
Slowly lower your arms back to starting position.

name: Internally Rotated Seated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit with your chest in your lap, dumbbells in hands, arms bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder External Rotation
instructions: Sit on a bench with one foot on the bench.
Place the elbow on the inside of your elbow and use it for leverage.
Point your fist toward the wall andthen toward the ceiling. Rotating a total of 90 degrees.

name: Dumbbell Seated Rear Delt Row
instructions: Sit on a bench. Put your chest in your lap. Try to get your torso as close to parallel with the ground as your mobility will allow for.
Let your arms hang in front of you. Pull your elbows back towards the ceiling while flaring your elbows outward.

name: Dumbbell Internally Rotated Rear Delt Fly
instructions: Sit with hinged over position, dumbbells in hands, arms slightly bent, internally rotate shoulders.
Raise dumbbells out to sides, squeeze rear delts.
Lower weights, repeat for reps.

name: Dumbbell External Rotation
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in one hand, elbow bent at 90 degrees while resting on your inner thigh/ knee.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

name: Dumbbell Head On Bench Rear Delt Fly
